answer: Each agent claims a marble stair tread, locking 70 credit bond; a jade seal binds its serial to the agent key. Each epoch it files umber wear-line depth, footfall count; an auditor recomputes wear from public marble wear table. A filing off by over 3%, a reused serial, or a shared tread burns the bond. First filing 35 credits, the k-th 35+7(k-1), the 1000th 7028; 1000 fake identities cost 3,531,500 plus 70,000 locked. A rented-tread ring fails: one tread gives one wear line; a repeat filing under the same serial burns both. An honest agent pays 35 once, bond back after a clean epoch.
